method: Every passage read in full. Scores are a reader's judgement, not a computed metric. Six passes per passage: comprehend, judge substance, judge prose, place in the corpus, judge question surface, argue against the score. Scores 1-10 on ten dimensions: A intellectual value, B curiosity, C depth, D originality, E naturalness, F memorability, G coherence, H CAT suitability, I engagement, J intellectual honesty.

tier_bar.S: Fresh idea + memorable concrete payload + prose with real texture (a scene, an image doing argumentative work, or a line that lands). Would survive being read beside the best essays in a good magazine.
tier_bar.A: Excellent and production-worthy. A real argument with a real reward, but the idea is canonical, or the prose is good without being distinctive, or the passage is too short to carry a full question set.
tier_bar.B: Good. The reward is curricular - the learner meets a famous idea, well explained - rather than a discovery.
tier_bar.C: Technically valid. The learner finishes without having gained much.

generations.gen1: rc-0001..rc-0032 (schema v3/v4, no structure field, essayistic first-person-plural voice, even paragraph lengths). Canonical ideas from the humanities and social-science curriculum, well explained.
generations.gen2: rc-0033..rc-0115 (schema v5, explicit structure field, impersonal analytic voice). Original arguments; markedly stronger, and markedly more uniform in method.

rows.reward: You cannot assess an expert's evidence, but you can assess the expert - track record, error-catching machinery, incentives, whether dissent is answered - and that is real cognitive work.
rows.memorable: Autonomy is not the refusal to trust; it is the ownership of one's reasons for trusting.
rows.note: Standard social epistemology. Examples (vaccine, rock stratum, bridge) are generic placeholders rather than cases.

rows.reward: A price transmits the conclusion of society's dispersed knowledge and none of the reasoning, which is exactly why it is superb at coordination and deaf to anything that never passes through a transaction.
rows.memorable: Pollution has no invoice; the price of coal has historically said little about the lungs it darkens.
rows.note: Hayek, but the third paragraph's conclusion-without-reasoning formulation is the author's own and is sharper than the source.

rows.reward: A published finding is a bet that the effect will recur, not an object that has been handed over; the literature is filtered to enrich for exactly the results least likely to survive.
rows.memorable: What looked like a crisis of results was in fact a crisis of a metaphor.
rows.note: The replication crisis is among the most-written science stories of the decade. Competent, not new.

rows.reward: When a proxy acquires consequences the measured acquire an interest in the number rather than the thing, and the two come apart precisely because the indicator now matters.
rows.memorable: The problem is structural, not moral, and moral exhortation is therefore close to useless against it.
rows.note: Goodhart's law, told the way everyone tells it. The remedies in the last paragraph (rotate measures, balance indicators, keep judgement) are the standard list and carry no argument. Superseded within the corpus by rc-0100, which makes a real claim about the same territory.

rows.reward: A first reading and a rereading are different activities: suspense spends attention on outcome, and shape can only be seen once the end is known.
rows.memorable: Suspense is a wonderful engine, but it is a greedy one.
rows.note: Genuinely fresh small observation, and the corollary - that the books people reread are rarely the ones with the cleverest plots - is earned. Thin question surface.

rows.reward: Understanding a description and possessing a procedure are stored by different systems, and only one of them is built by reading.
rows.memorable: 'I understood the chapter' and 'I can do the problems' are such different claims.
rows.note: Textbook declarative/procedural memory. Its value here is that it is aimed squarely at this product's own user, which is worth more than its originality.

rows.reward: The weekend was assembled out of religious rest, a drinking habit called Saint Monday, and a payroll calculation - and the three parties each wanted a different weekend, so the institution had to stay vague enough to hold all three.
rows.memorable: Saint Monday: absenteeism so regular it earned a name.
rows.note: Real historical facts doing real argumentative work. One of the few passages in the corpus whose reward is knowledge of the world rather than a distinction.

rows.reward: Translation is interpretation that cannot hedge: where the source permits two meanings the target demands a choice, so what is lost is indeterminacy and what is bought is commitment.
rows.memorable: The court that tries the translator sits, so to speak, in a borrowed building.
rows.note: The strongest of the first generation. Three independent moves (the original is itself an edition; translation is reading made answerable; disagreement is evidence not scandal) and an excellent question surface.

rows.reward: Most moral work is done before any choice arrives, in the long interval during which we were describing the world to ourselves; what looks like a fork is the last step of a path.
rows.memorable: The gaze is not passive. It is the slowest of our actions.
rows.note: Murdoch on attention, faithfully and beautifully rendered. The 'needy where she might have seen loyal' example is the best thing in the first generation.

rows.reward: Small talk is measured by what it maintains rather than what it transmits, which is why its formulas never need updating.
rows.memorable: As one might fault a handshake for carrying no cargo.
rows.note: Phatic communion, the textbook account. The corpus's own rc-0060 does the identical move (an act whose point is the performing, not the conveying) with far more at stake.

rows.reward: Labour-intensive services grow relatively costlier as an economy succeeds, because their wages are pulled up by productivity they do not share - so rising cost is the arithmetic of success, not of decline.
rows.memorable: They are the still points against which the acceleration everywhere else is measured.
rows.note: Baumol. Counterintuitive, mechanically explained, and the final paragraph turns it into a genuine political choice without editorialising.

rows.reward: Reducible in principle is a claim about the world; reducible in practice is a claim about us, and the reductive story slides from the first to the second.
rows.memorable: Defeating not our physics but our arithmetic.
rows.note: The in-principle / in-practice split is the whole value and it is made cleanly. Turns emergence from mysticism into a claim about tractable computation.

rows.reward: A large part of liking comes from bare repetition, and the warmth arrives without a label, so the mind supplies one and credits the object.
rows.memorable: Some of our tastes are not verdicts on the world; they are records of where we have already been.
rows.note: Mere exposure, at textbook depth. A very good closing line carrying a very thin argument - which is exactly the pattern this audit is meant to catch. The line is doing the work the reasoning should do.

rows.reward: The astonishing thing an election achieves is on the losing side: consent not to the decision but to the way it was reached.
rows.memorable: An election is a ritual for manufacturing losers who will consent to lose.
rows.note: A genuine reframe with immediate diagnostic use, and the closing warning earns itself.

rows.reward: The worry about automated decisions is not the decision but the decider: a faculty never exercised never arrives, and its absence is invisible to the person missing it.
rows.memorable: Moral deskilling removes the very faculty by which one might perceive that something is missing.
rows.note: Careful, well-qualified, and one of the most-written essays of the decade. Paragraph 3 (stating the claim carefully) is excellent craft.

rows.reward: A weak tie carries novelty not by trying harder but by sitting between two clusters that would otherwise share nothing.
rows.memorable: The friend who would lend you a kidney may be the last to hear of the opening you need.
rows.note: Granovetter, famous, crisply told, and the final sentence is the best closer in the first generation.

rows.reward: Standard time is less accurate than solar time, not more; what it bought was not truth but the ability of people spread across space to act as though they shared a single now.
rows.memorable: A town might have two noons, one for the townsfolk and one for the station.
rows.note: Real history, well-chosen detail, and a final paragraph that resists the obvious progress narrative.

rows.reward: If nature is by definition the place without us, everywhere we are becomes by definition not nature, and the wilderness ideal turns into a permission slip for ruining everywhere else.
rows.memorable: The emptiness is not the absence of a human past; it is the erasure of one.
rows.note: Cronon, the standard environmental-humanities essay, made well. The consequence in paragraph 4 is the part that earns its place.

rows.reward: What we value in a made thing includes its history, which is the one property a perfect copy cannot reproduce.
rows.memorable: The two are identical in every visible respect and different in the one respect that cannot be seen at all - their past.
rows.note: The perfect-forgery thought experiment, a staple of undergraduate aesthetics. Well made; nothing here a reader of the subject has not met.

rows.reward: Losing the author as the owner of meaning does not abolish constraint; the reading still answers to what the words can bear in a shared language.
rows.memorable: Freedom from the author is not freedom from the poem.
rows.note: The intentional fallacy at seminar-handout depth. The fourth paragraph is the only part that is not summary, and rc-0008 covers the same territory with an actual thesis.

rows.reward: A market can fail through nothing but an asymmetry of information, with every party reasoning correctly, and the institutions that look like ornaments on a market are what let it exist at all.
rows.memorable: Warranties, brands and certifications are not frictions added to a smooth market; they are the load-bearing walls.
rows.note: Akerlof. Famous, but the descending spiral is staged better than most textbooks manage, and the fifth paragraph is a genuine payoff rather than a summary.

rows.reward: A history is an answer to a question asked of the past, and questions change while the evidence still constrains the answers.
rows.memorable: Distance is not only a source of distortion; it is also a source of sight.
rows.note: Sound, standard historiography. The final paragraph's refusal of relativism is the right move and the expected one.

rows.reward: Two commitments - that blame attaches to the will, and that the driver who killed did something the other did not - are both indispensable and cannot both be honoured.
rows.memorable: Strip away everything a person did not control and the self that remains seems to shrink toward a vanishing point.
rows.note: Moral luck, and one of only two or three passages in the corpus that ends without a resolution. That refusal is worth more than the familiarity of the case costs it.

rows.reward: Since an action cannot be undone, the cheaper repair is to revise the belief, so some of our firmest convictions are consequences of behaviour rather than causes of it.
rows.memorable: When we find ourselves most certain that a costly path was the right one, that is exactly the moment the certainty deserves a second look.
rows.note: Cognitive dissonance and effort justification at introductory depth. rc-0099 handles the neighbouring territory with an actual argument and a testable consequence.

rows.reward: Democracy cannot democratically decide who the people are: every attempt must borrow in advance a boundary it has not yet drawn.
rows.memorable: Every democracy rests on a foundation it did not lay and cannot fully justify in its own language.
rows.note: The boundary problem, genuinely hard and much less famous than its neighbours. The 'all affected' paragraph is a proper refutation rather than a gesture.

rows.t: No Such Thing as a Free Gift
rows.reward: The etiquette that disguises a gift as free is the machinery that makes the obligation binding.
rows.memorable: The fiction of the free gift is, paradoxically, essential to the obligation the gift creates.
rows.note: DEFECT: question 4 is typed vocabulary_in_context and tests 'disinterested', a word that does not appear anywhere in the passage - the stem has to gloss it parenthetically to make sense. It is a paraphrase question wearing the wrong label. Retype it or replace it with a word the passage actually uses. Content otherwise sound Mauss.

rows.reward: The size of a panic tells you nothing about the size of the problem, because intensity tracks symbolic charge rather than measurable harm.
rows.memorable: The first casualty of a panic is proportion.
rows.note: Largely descriptive. There is no opposing view taken seriously, no mechanism examined closely, and nothing the author has to concede - the thinnest argument in the corpus. Compare rc-0057, which takes the neighbouring subject and builds a real distinction out of it.

rows.reward: No number of confirmations establishes a universal claim and one counter-instance destroys it, so a theory earns standing by surviving attempts to kill it.
rows.memorable: What cannot fail cannot inform.
rows.note: Popper's falsifiability, told in Popper's own example, reaching Popper's own conclusion. The single most widely rehearsed argument in the corpus and the one that adds least. The corpus already has rc-0102, rc-0058 and rc-0082 doing far better work on the same shelf.

rows.t: The Freedom of the Fourteen Lines
rows.reward: A constraint replaces an empty field with a definite problem and forbids the first, easy option, which pushes the maker past the ready-made.
rows.memorable: Using the wall not as a cage but as the thing to climb.
rows.note: The weakest reasoning in the corpus. Both offered reasons are assertions - 'infinite freedom is paralysing', 'the artist is pushed to search further' - with no evidence, no counter-case and no mechanism. rc-0111 handles artistic difficulty properly, with a test. This one should be rebuilt around that standard or dropped.

rows.reward: Where attention is the product, engagement and the user's good are different quantities, and the conflict is built into who pays.
rows.memorable: A design aimed at engagement can never tell you that you have seen enough.
rows.note: The single most-written argument of the last fifteen years, reproduced without a new premise, a new case or a new consequence. Nothing in it would surprise a reader who has spent an hour online. Replace: the slot is worth more spent on something the learner has not already been told.

rows.reward: Emotion answers to what is vividly held before the mind rather than to what is believed, which is why a remembered humiliation still stings and an imagined catastrophe can spoil a safe present.
rows.memorable: Fiction moves us because it exploits, honestly and openly, a capacity we use, and are used by, all the time.
rows.note: The paradox of fiction, standard but well staged, and the fourth paragraph's extension beyond the cinema is what lifts it.

rows.reward: Defending a forest by its price concedes that price is what matters, and what pays can always be outbid.
rows.memorable: The argument that rescues nature on Monday licenses its destruction on Tuesday.
rows.note: The strongest ending in the first generation, and the recommendation - use the number as a weapon, not a truth - is unusually practical.

rows.reward: Most rules are deposited rather than designed, and removing one feels costless precisely because the harm it prevented is no longer occurring.
rows.memorable: The organisation remembers what its members have forgotten.
rows.note: Chesterton's fence with actual machinery: the deposit mechanism, the success-then-regret asymmetry, and a stated limit for genuine fossils.

rows.reward: A conversational norm is invisible because it operates before interpretation begins - by the time you notice the silence you have already judged it - which is why knowing that norms differ changes nothing.
rows.memorable: In some communities a pause of a full second is an invitation. In others the same pause is a wound.
rows.note: 202 words, the shortest in the corpus, carrying a genuinely good idea on three questions. Under-exploited.

rows.t: Which Error Would You Rather Make?
rows.reward: Both defaults - permit until harmful, restrain until safe - are choices about which error a society would rather make, so neither side has escaped the problem of acting under uncertainty.
rows.memorable: He has simply chosen the one whose costs fall later and on someone else.
rows.note: Model adjudication. Gives the critics their best case, gives the defenders their best case, and locates the real disagreement below both.

rows.t: The Question the Pilot Never Asks
rows.reward: A pilot and a rollout are not two measurements of one quantity: the first asks whether the intervention works when done properly, the second whether an organisation whose scarcest input is attention will get it done properly often enough.
rows.memorable: A successful pilot is a loan against the organisation's attention, and a rollout is the demand for repayment.
rows.note: Takes two standard corrections, shows both refine an estimate of the wrong quantity, and ends with a commissioning rule an official could act on tomorrow. Original and useful.

rows.reward: Satire's force is borrowed entirely from what the target has staked on an audience's good opinion; a figure who never asked to be thought serious owns nothing the laughter can take.
rows.memorable: The old sketch changed what a minister could afford to do. The new one changes only what we can still bear to notice.
rows.note: The best-written passage in the corpus. A real scene (eight people in a cold room, the pause before a lie), an argument that explains a live phenomenon, and a refusal to console itself at the end.

rows.t: What Travels and What Does Not
rows.reward: A prohibition costs abstention, which one person can pay alone; a procedure costs coordination, which a group must pay - so dispersal dissolves the procedures and leaves the prohibitions, and the tradition looks intact from both sides long after it has stopped organising anyone's day.
rows.memorable: The wall comes down from the inside by the ordinary operation of timetables.
rows.note: Splits a category everyone treats as one and derives a real prediction from the split. Assimilation without a convert or a crisis is a genuinely new thing to have been shown.

rows.reward: A grammar does not wall off thoughts; it obliges certain questions to be settled before a sentence will close, and doing that a few thousand times a day builds a habit of attention.
rows.memorable: A language decides what its speakers must have thought about by the time they reach the end of a sentence.
rows.note: Linguistic relativity handled properly, with a prediction that distinguishes the account from its rival and a note that the prediction is roughly what is observed.

rows.reward: A proof is a certificate and an explanation at once; the explanation lives in one or two steps, and a reader who checks every step with equal care gives the decisive one least attention.
rows.memorable: The certificate has not changed. The reader has.
rows.note: Fresh, directly actionable, and aimed at the product's user. 341 words and three questions - under-exploited.

rows.reward: A manner claims nothing about feeling, which is why it is not hypocrisy and why it can make consideration reliable on the days it would not have been summoned.
rows.memorable: A person with manners has made a promise that their mood is not consulted about.
rows.note: Makes the case against its own thesis first and at full strength, then dismantles it with a distinction that had to be found rather than recalled. The host taking the coat is the right example and it is placed exactly where it does most work. MISCALIBRATED: tagged difficulty 3 / easy.

rows.reward: A thing is sacred because it is forbidden, not forbidden because it is sacred - a reversal that turned the study of the sacred from theology into sociology and let the category find flags and founding documents.
rows.memorable: Defenders reply that the prohibition was always the phenomenon, and the gods were only ever its explanation.
rows.note: Clean intellectual history in 334 words, ending on a live dispute rather than a verdict. Three questions is too few for it.

rows.reward: A causal story bears on a belief only when the route would have delivered the same thing had the facts been otherwise; what does the work is the insensitivity of the process, not the impurity of the motive.
rows.memorable: To ask why a man believes something is, nine times in ten, to have finished disagreeing with him.
rows.note: The genetic fallacy, but the sensitivity test in paragraph 3 is a real contribution and the second paragraph's diagnosis of why the fallacy keeps working is better than the textbook version.

rows.reward: The gambler's fallacy and the expectation of a streak are one habit meeting two assumptions about the source, and only one of the pair is an invalid inference - the other is a valid inference about a badly identified source.
rows.memorable: The same person, on the same evening, will wait for black at the wheel and back the player who cannot miss.
rows.note: Takes a matched pair every textbook teaches together and argues it should be broken up, with a consequence for what the cure should be. The cleanest original thesis in the corpus.

rows.t: The Repair That Was a Move
rows.reward: A reform is a move, not a repair: the drawing shows the first move, and what designers call an unintended consequence is a second move by people who understood the first.
rows.memorable: A machine's parts do not notice that they have been repaired. People do.
rows.note: 305 words, perfectly built, three examples that each land. Three questions - under-exploited.

rows.t: Only One Thing at a Time
rows.reward: Every causal claim already contains a counterfactual, so the question is which can be run well - minimal rewrite, short chain - and what a good one establishes is contingency, not an alternative past.
rows.memorable: The historians who press the charge spend their working lives writing 'the harvest failure precipitated the revolt'.
rows.note: Turns the standard objection against the objectors in one move, then supplies two conditions that actually sort the field, then deflates its own conclusion honestly.

rows.reward: A trial average is an estimate for whoever resembles the enrolled, so the whole weight falls on resemblance in the respects that bear on mechanism or harm - and an unnamed difference is not a reason to depart from the result.
rows.memorable: Uniqueness that cannot be specified is the absence of evidence wearing the clothes of evidence.
rows.note: Genuinely useful to anyone who will ever be a patient, and the last paragraph refuses the easy victory by conceding what happens when the difference is named well.

rows.reward: The rule of law is a multiplier rather than a gift: it makes usable whatever room the content of the law leaves, so it is enormously valuable applied to a generous content and worth nothing applied to none.
rows.memorable: The tyranny with good records has multiplied a zero with great care.
rows.note: 348 words and a complete dialectic. The closing sentence does more work than most passages manage in five paragraphs. Three questions - under-exploited.

rows.t: The Tools That Happened to Fit
rows.reward: Most mathematics never fits anything, and physicists search for the parts that do, so much of the miracle is an artefact of how the cases are counted - though a residue survives the deflation.
rows.memorable: The puzzle is smaller than it is usually made to look, and something is left over.
rows.note: 267 words and honest about its own residue, which is the right instinct. The slightest of the good short passages; the argument is two observations rather than a mechanism.

rows.reward: Courts never read minds: intent is imputed from conduct by standing presumption, which answers the sceptic and simultaneously shrinks the difference the traditional defence of intent relies on.
rows.memorable: An imputation is a finding rather than a finding out.
rows.note: The rare passage that answers an objection and then turns on the side it just rescued. That double movement is what makes the question surface excellent.

rows.reward: The defence of misleading - that the hearer completes the inference himself - fails once the sentence was chosen for that inference; what survives is a difference in exposure rather than in guilt, which is why the distinction earns its keep under oath and thins at a kitchen table.
rows.memorable: Crediting the victim with the final movement of his own mind is like calling a man innocent of a push because gravity did the falling.
rows.note: Opens in a scene with no commentary at all, demolishes the standard defence, then finds the smaller thing that really does survive and says exactly where it applies. Among the three best passages in the corpus.

rows.reward: A garment is judged on the body in front of you and a dish against a remembered one, so a departure at the table reads as error rather than novelty - which is why cuisines move when migration removes the supply and excuses the substitution.
rows.memorable: The cook who improvises is not, at that table, being bold. He is being wrong.
rows.note: A question nobody thinks to ask, answered with two mechanisms and a prediction about when the rule breaks. 302 words, three questions - badly under-exploited.

rows.t: A Good Test in the Wrong Room
rows.reward: Accuracy is a property of the test; the chance that a positive result is right is a property of the test together with the people it is used on, and those people can change while the test does not.
rows.memorable: Nothing about the device has altered. Only the room it is standing in.
rows.note: Base rates - very widely taught - but this is the sharpest framing of it I have read, and the closing line is the corpus's best. 257 words and three questions.

rows.reward: The complaint that a nudge influences you proves too much, since no arrangement is neutral; what people actually resent is influence that works only while they do not know about it, which yields a test - explain it and see whether it survives.
rows.memorable: It borrowed its effect from your ignorance and gave it back the moment the ignorance ended.
rows.note: The four-screens cancellation page is the perfect worked example, and the final paragraph refuses to let the test do more than it can. MISCALIBRATED: tagged difficulty 3 / easy for a 638-word ethical argument.

rows.reward: Rearrangement is not itself a virtue, but order is never neutral: it fixes what the reader knows as each event arrives, and therefore which questions are available to him.
rows.memorable: A writer who has not noticed that he is choosing has chosen anyway.
rows.note: Begins by conceding what the subject is usually taught to prove, which is the right instinct. 317 words, three questions.

rows.t: The Word That Needs a Sentence
rows.reward: Untranslatability began as a claim about what speakers could think, retreated under testing to a claim about what one word can carry, and now records only how many words a rendering takes - so what is lost is form, not meaning.
rows.memorable: The test applied is length.
rows.note: Tracks a claim's retreat across three stages and shows that the surviving version points a translator in the opposite direction from the original. Original and quietly devastating.

rows.reward: An omission and a standing account of why the other side should not be believed are different structures, and exposure - the cure for the first - is the diet of the second.
rows.memorable: Immunity, not isolation, is the property worth naming, and it is much the harder of the two to see from outside.
rows.note: Says in 316 words what the echo-chamber literature has failed to say in a decade, and refuses to let the distinction become a label for people one disagrees with. Three questions for an idea that deserves six - the corpus's most under-exploited passage.

rows.reward: What lets a controlled experiment show a cause is not the laboratory but the unrelated sorting, so events in the world can do the same work - at the price of having to argue the sorting was unrelated instead of knowing it.
rows.memorable: It is not the equipment, and it is certainly not the white coat. It is the coin.
rows.note: Deliberately plain diction carrying a genuinely important methodological point, with four real natural experiments and four real ways they fail. MISCALIBRATED: tagged difficulty 1 / foundation for a 639-word argument with a weaken question.

rows.reward: The shared-pasture parable is an idealisation on the model of a frictionless plane: its inevitability is manufactured by what was removed to build it, so it forecasts well only where those removals are real.
rows.memorable: These are not properties of sharing. They are properties of a crowd of strangers.
rows.note: The frictionless-plane comparison is exactly right and does the whole job. Names the five things the parable removed, which is the move the parable's users never make.

rows.reward: A meeting is judged by information transfer, the one thing it does worst; what a room does that an email cannot is distribute responsibility, because everybody in it can see who else heard.
rows.memorable: A written notice distributes information and leaves no trace of who has read it. A room distributes responsibility.
rows.note: Borrows the anthropological sense of ritual and applies it without letting the account become a defence - paragraph 4 explicitly refuses that, which is what makes the final reframing land.

rows.reward: The paired case built to test doing against allowing deletes the competing claims that make the two duties different in kind, so its verdict describes the case rather than the distinction.
rows.memorable: That the difference vanishes there is not a discovery about the difference. It is a description of the case.
rows.note: A first-rate methodological objection to a whole genre of thought experiment, and it refuses to convert that objection into a defence of the distinction. The honesty of the last paragraph is the best thing in it.

rows.reward: Human capital and signalling make identical predictions about earnings, so the data the quarrel is conducted with cannot settle it; only cases where the certificate and the course come apart can.
rows.memorable: A measurement on which two rival explanations agree cannot adjudicate between them, however large the sample.
rows.note: 301 words containing a complete methodological lesson that generalises far beyond education. Three questions - under-exploited.

rows.reward: Prohibitions protect a scheme of kinds rather than a body, which is why they cluster on the anomalous, why they appear where no contagion is alleged, and why they lapse when the classification stops organising anything.
rows.memorable: Prohibitions are very seldom repealed on evidence. They are abandoned when nothing any longer depends on the line they were drawn to defend.
rows.note: Douglas, done at full strength with three independent supports - and then the sixth paragraph turns on the account with the objection that actually threatens it. The best self-criticism in the corpus.

rows.t: The Wars That Did Not Come
rows.reward: Deterrence and the disappearance of conquest as a stateable aim answer different questions, and the place they come apart is the wars the great powers did fight - many, destructive, and almost none ending with the victor keeping the ground.
rows.memorable: How much of the restraint each was producing is a quantity the record does not contain.
rows.note: Finds a real discriminating test between two accounts usually left as rivals, and then refuses to announce a winner on evidence that does not exist.

rows.t: Not Quite the One You Wanted
rows.reward: The imitation-and-flight cycle assumes a mark that can be bought exactly; a mark whose price is accumulated cannot be completed by a copier, so it is never abandoned, and the test moves from possession to manner.
rows.memorable: What had been established, gently and beyond appeal, was that the guest could buy the rug and would still not have the thing.
rows.note: The finest single piece of writing in the corpus. The dinner exchange is fiction of real quality and does the entire argumentative job before any argument begins. Attacks the standard account of status at its load-bearing assumption and wins.

rows.reward: An advance made for revenue carries its own arithmetic brake; an advance made for safety has none, because the frontier manufactures the danger afresh - so the expansions that broke empires were characteristically the defensive ones.
rows.memorable: What lacks a stopping rule is not conquest. It is conquest justified by fear.
rows.note: Replaces a verdict on appetite with a mechanism about stopping rules, and then names the exact condition under which the mechanism fails. MISCALIBRATED: tagged difficulty 3 / easy.

rows.t: The Copy That Must Be Made Again
rows.reward: What fails in a digital object is not the bits but the apparatus that interprets them, so preservation stops being an act and becomes a recurring decision - which ends the oldest property of an archive, that neglect was survivable.
rows.memorable: The material is intact. The reader has gone.
rows.note: Explains a familiar fact by a mechanism nobody states, derives a consequence about which records survive, and then refuses to call the change a net loss. The institutional-continuity ending is unanswerable.

rows.reward: Liability without fault relocates fault rather than abandoning it - to the decision to carry on the activity - which means it is worth only what that earlier choice was worth, and worth nothing where the work was the work available.
rows.memorable: The doctrine does not abolish fault. It moves the question from the conduct of an activity to the decision to carry it on.
rows.note: Finds the hidden premise, supplies the defence, then states the exact conditions under which the defence collapses - and ends by conceding the difficulty that remains even when it holds.

rows.reward: The safe-street list is written for a street with nobody in it, so each item substitutes for company - and a street rebuilt to it loses the small frontages that generate the company.
rows.memorable: A lamp cannot be appealed to, a cleared sightline will not come out of a doorway, and a patrol is somewhere else.
rows.note: Jacobs, but with an argumentative engine she did not supply: asking from what standpoint the list was drawn up. The loop in paragraph 4 - reassurance produces presence, but only where there is an errand - keeps the concession honest.

rows.reward: The cobra story is thinly sourced and it does not matter, because the condition it makes visible is testable: the failure requires a reward paid on a token the collector can manufacture.
rows.memorable: A phrase that can be used against everything tells you nothing about anything.
rows.note: Leads with the fact that its own parable is probably invented, which is first-rate intellectual hygiene, and then rescues exactly the part that survives. Pairs with rc-0112 on the same structure.

rows.reward: A statement can be true of one household and false of all households together, which makes the paradox of thrift a claim about which level a description belongs to rather than a verdict on virtue.
rows.memorable: What is prudence in the parlour is subtraction in the ledger.
rows.note: States the condition the paradox depends on - and that is fatal to omit - which most popular accounts leave out, then refuses both moral readings.

rows.reward: A legal fiction issues an instruction rather than a proposition, so it cannot be a lie; what it really costs is that the moment of decision is hidden, which makes the objection constitutional rather than moral.
rows.memorable: It is announced in the judgment, printed in the reports, and explained to students in their first month, which is an unusual way to conduct a fraud.
rows.note: Replaces a two-century-old charge with a better one and then admits the new charge supplies no way of telling which case a court is in. That last refusal is what separates this from a clever defence.

rows.reward: A museum certifies value rather than discovering it, like a mint - and the analogy breaks exactly where a museum's authority is reputational and revocable, which is why selling a work is a scandal and melting a coin is routine.
rows.memorable: A museum can spend thirty years certifying what the next generation will look at and see nothing in.
rows.note: Model use of an analogy: pressed through three tests, broken at one joint, and the break itself explains a behaviour the ordinary account cannot.

rows.reward: Procrastination is the repair of a mood, not a misjudgement of time - which predicts that delay tracks a task's emotional charge rather than its length, and that schedules will disappoint.
rows.memorable: He knows precisely what the delay will cost him, and that knowledge is among the things he is at present arranging not to feel.
rows.note: A definition defended by what it predicts, which is the right way to defend one. 286 words, three questions - under-exploited.

rows.reward: Asking whether there is evidence that a policy works is three demands - is the effect real, will this machinery reproduce it, is the result the one we wanted - and only the first is evidential.
rows.memorable: A dispute about what we want is closed by a demonstration of what works.
rows.note: The detention-and-release example makes the third question unanswerable by data in a single sentence, and the fifth paragraph recalls what the demand displaced, which stops the argument becoming a complaint.

rows.reward: Writing's independence from speech is functional, not material: the devices written prose grew - the paragraph, the sustained subordinate clause, the footnote - answer the one predicament a speaker never has, that he cannot be interrupted and cannot repair.
rows.memorable: They are what a sentence needs when it must survive without its author.
rows.note: Concedes the opponent's best answer at full strength, explicitly costing itself its most quotable example, and then wins on different ground. The most intellectually generous passage in the corpus.

rows.reward: The printed interview moves the custody of a statement from the paper to a named speaker, which is why the early specimens are empty of news and why the objection to it was about ownership and timing rather than truth.
rows.memorable: It has undertaken only that the words were spoken.
rows.note: Uses the emptiness of the early examples and the shape of the contemporary objection as two independent confirmations, then concedes the rare disclosure while denying it can account for a universal form. DEFECT: the title near-duplicates rc-0098 'Out of His Own Words'. Retitle one.

rows.reward: Comparative advantage is refused for two different reasons - an arithmetic mistake that teaching cures, and a clear view of who pays that teaching cannot - and a third: the theorem is stated about countries and met in the form of a job.
rows.memorable: The standard reply is that the winners gain enough to compensate the losers and still be ahead. That is true, and the objection to it is short: could is not does.
rows.note: Explains why fifty years of explaining has failed, which is a better question than whether the principle is true. The boatyards are the clearest worked example in the corpus. MISCALIBRATED: tagged difficulty 3 / easy for a 749-word adjudication.

rows.reward: Urban anonymity is not a service the city failed to supply but the same arrangement seen from the other end: the power to decide what is known, worth most to whoever can manage alone and costing most to whoever cannot.
rows.memorable: She was her father's daughter. Every one of these went ahead of her into every room she entered, and none of it was hers to release or to withhold.
rows.note: Holds two people in view - the woman in the bread shop and the old woman in the flat above - without letting either cancel the other, and then narrows the remedy to something buildable. Refuses the consolation its own argument invites.

rows.reward: Tolerance as a temper has a quantity and no terms, so nothing inside it can say when to stop; tolerance as a settlement has parties and terms, so a party who refuses has declined an offer rather than been expelled.
rows.memorable: Nobody builds an appeal procedure to protect a disposition.
rows.note: Dissolves the paradox of tolerance by changing what kind of thing tolerance is, then denies itself the comfort - the obligation becomes conditional, and the offer costs something every year.

rows.reward: Free indirect style produces closeness by deleting the reporting verb, which leaves nowhere to locate the mediation - and the same deletion removes the warrant that makes an unreliable report detectable.
rows.memorable: The access is manufactured by a subtraction. Nothing whatever has been added to the characterisation.
rows.note: Technically the most accomplished passage in the corpus: three sample sentences, a rival account, a grammatical explanation, a consequence for unreliability, a falsifying prediction, and two limits - one of them on its own use of the word illusion.

rows.reward: Precision can be computed from the readings and accuracy cannot, so the interval printed after a measurement is characteristically a statement about repeatability wearing the label of a statement about truth.
rows.memorable: An apparatus asked about its own accuracy is a ruler asked to measure itself, and it will report that it is exactly a foot long.
rows.note: Explains a mistake everybody knows how to avoid and nobody avoids, with published constants as evidence and a prescription deliberately smaller than the diagnosis. The last sentence names the real reason the distinction is hard to keep.

rows.reward: The forgetting that feels like failure is the part that works, and a learner's one instrument for judging progress - how easy the material feels - reads the reverse of the truth.
rows.memorable: It asks a person to choose, every day, the method that will feel worse, on somebody else's word, against the only evidence he has.
rows.note: Concedes what cramming is genuinely good for before attacking it, which most spacing-effect writing refuses to do. Directly relevant to this product's user. MISCALIBRATED: tagged difficulty 2 / easy.

rows.t: The Grass That Never Runs Out
rows.reward: The commons frame is the best of the three descriptions of open source because it treats the practice as an institution, and it imports one mistake: the danger is desertion rather than depletion, so the governing rules are reciprocity conditions rather than rationing.
rows.memorable: There are not too many takers. There are too few givers.
rows.note: Keeps a borrowed frame and corrects it at exactly one joint, naming the substitution precisely. The library maintained by one unpaid person is the right closing image.

rows.t: The Thing You Cannot Hand Over
rows.reward: Belief cannot be chosen because of what believing is, not because the will is weak - but attention and company are voluntary, so what can be demanded is the looking and what cannot is the landing.
rows.memorable: Offer a man a large sum to believe in the second moon and you have given him a powerful motive and no reason whatever.
rows.note: Opens with an instruction the reader can carry out and fail at, which settles the premise before any argument. The looking/landing division is the kind of distinction a reader keeps.

rows.reward: In the cases that actually arise nothing is deleted and only retrieval changes, so the right to be forgotten is an attempt to restore by rule the friction a filing cabinet used to supply - and that friction was never evenly spread.
rows.memorable: Publicity was a permission and not a delivery.
rows.note: Dissolves a twenty-year argument by noticing what both sides took for granted, and then turns the sting on the side it appeared to support: the right requires somebody to decide, name by name, which enquirers count as neighbours.

rows.reward: An expensive advertisement is a security posted against the seller's own future: what the buyer reads is the expenditure, not the copy - which is why the message certifies nothing where the seller does not expect a second meeting.
rows.memorable: Both camps were reading the copy while the message was in the bill.
rows.note: Breaks a hundred-year deadlock by noticing that both sides were examining the wrong part of the advertisement, then bounds the claim precisely at the restaurant by the station. Grants the opposing camp two points it genuinely deserves.

rows.reward: Submitting to the penalty is not evidence of sincerity or fidelity but the thing that makes a breach an appeal rather than an exit - which is why it is suspended where the penalty is itself the injustice complained of.
rows.memorable: A man may be as conscientious as he likes in a cellar.
rows.note: Begins by defining the term because the quarrel is conducted without one, demolishes two standard defences, supplies a third that is constitutive rather than evidential, and then sorts four cases against it.

rows.t: The Cousin Who Knows the Agent
rows.reward: A ceiling changes the currency rather than the price, and a price paid in hours is not a transfer: the hours are received by nobody and simply dissipate.
rows.memorable: A queue is a price expressed in hours.
rows.note: Starts exactly where the textbook stops, and the transfer/dissipation distinction is a permanent addition to a reader's economics. 342 words, three questions - badly under-exploited.

rows.reward: Preparation does not make an accident likelier - give that up - but it changes what the accident is taken for, since an anomaly can only be a finding to somebody holding a theory precise enough for it to contradict.
rows.memorable: The unprepared observer sees a mess, not because he is watching less closely, but because he has nothing that the mess contradicts.
rows.note: States the objection to a beloved maxim at full strength, including the unfalsifiability charge, concedes exactly half, and ends with a budget line rather than an exhortation.

rows.reward: Compliance rests on the acknowledged standing of the body issuing a demand, not the price of disobeying: the expected penalty is too small to produce the observed obedience, and compliance moves with fairness while enforcement stands still.
rows.memorable: Legitimacy is cheap and enforcement is dear, so an authority that spends the first will find the cost of the second arriving in a form it cannot pay.
rows.note: Three independent supports, then a real grant to the opponent - the sanction is a constituent of a legal demand - carefully distinguished from the claim being refused.

rows.reward: The idea of progress did not die but changed address, from morals to departments - and a claim about departments cannot license the argument the old claim licensed, that a present cost is redeemed by the direction of the whole.
rows.memorable: A better anaesthetic justifies nothing outside the operating theatre.
rows.note: Gives the better description to one account and the better sense of the loss to the other, and insists both halves are needed. The refusal to treat the change as merely verbal is the argument's real work.

rows.reward: Producing reasons is composition, not reporting: what can be said is weighted because the list becomes the thing consulted, so a preference pressed through language comes out tilted towards what language is good at.
rows.memorable: Language is superb at quantities, categories and comparisons, and poor at whatever has to be pointed to rather than named.
rows.note: The opening is a short story with no commentary in it, and the detail that settles the argument - her decision moved while every item on the list stayed put - is planted there without emphasis. Then the account is neither of the two available ones. Among the very best.

rows.t: The Number He Will Give You
rows.reward: Risk and uncertainty are not separated by whether probabilities are known - a number can always be produced - but by whether the list of outcomes is closed, and no quantity of observation lengthens a list.
rows.memorable: A wrong number is a reason to measure again. A short list is a reason to stop believing the total.
rows.note: 318 words redrawing a famous distinction in a way that changes what you do about it. Concedes that no real list is wholly closed. Three questions - under-exploited.

rows.reward: Prices rise fast and fall slowly because a cost rise is public and removes the point of searching while a fall is invisible at the counter - appetite is symmetrical and therefore cannot produce an asymmetry.
rows.memorable: Greed is a constant, and a constant cannot explain a difference.
rows.note: Teaches a permanently useful reasoning move, supplies a place the pattern should be weaker so the account can be tested, and explicitly declines to exclude rival explanations.

rows.reward: Defined by the substitution of instruction for price, a platform is a firm - an unusually thorough one that does not employ - so the boundary of the firm and the boundary of the employment relation, coincident for a century, have come apart.
rows.memorable: It moves the problem of proof, from what a worker can be called to what a company can be made to disclose.
rows.note: Applies a 1937 definition to a 2020s arrangement and gets a result the litigation has not reached, then names the cost of its own remedy: the only continuous record of direction is the one the platform keeps.

rows.reward: The usual explanation of why careful words wear out says nothing about why they wear out at such different speeds; the fast cases are the ones adopted as official categories, because a word repeated by clerks who feel nothing gathers the situation it stands beside.
rows.memorable: Take the careful words in your own language that have lasted longest, and count how many have ever appeared at the top of a column.
rows.note: Accepts the standard account in full and then finds the question it cannot answer, which is a better move than refuting it. Ends with a test the reader can run this afternoon. MISCALIBRATED: tagged difficulty 3 / foundation.

rows.reward: A reason was originally a commitment that bound the decider, so it could be false as autobiography and still do its work; each stage of algorithmic transparency has moved inspection further from the thing that decides, and what has gone is not access but exposure.
rows.memorable: A reason could be argued with, because somebody had to stand behind it; a disclosure can only be checked.
rows.note: Recovers what reason-giving originally meant and uses it to measure everything since - the best-constructed argument in the corpus. DEFECT: title near-duplicates rc-0077 'Out of His Own Mouth'. Retitle one.

rows.t: Not the Belief but the Standard
rows.reward: What is doubled in self-deception is the standard of evidence, not the belief - and that removes the deceiver but not the puzzle, since an unequal threshold has to be aimed, and aiming requires that the content already be registered.
rows.memorable: The self-deceived man is the one who attends to his situation far more closely than anybody around him.
rows.note: Offers a solution and then refuses it the status of one, which almost nothing written on self-deception does. The testable consequence in the last paragraph is what makes the refusal credible rather than modest.

rows.t: What the Mark Is Paying For
rows.reward: A grade's two functions are each the other's condition - a mark records conduct while the mark was at stake, and it moves nobody once nobody will read it - so the question is not how to separate them but what rate of exchange a scheme is accepting.
rows.memorable: What behaviour the scheme pays for, and whether that is the behaviour anybody wanted to measure.
rows.note: Shows the standard reform to be an amputation rather than a tidying, then prices three real schemes against each other. Supersedes rc-0004 on the same shelf.

rows.reward: Federal variation fails three of the four things a laboratory supplies, and fails them all in the same direction, so the stream of results is not noisy but encouraging - and the fourth failure, that subjects move between conditions, is the one better practice cannot repair.
rows.memorable: The more freely people move to the arrangement that suits them, the better the federation works as a settlement and the worse it works as an experiment.
rows.note: Takes a two-century-old figure of speech literally enough to check it item by item, and ends by relocating the case for federalism entirely - from knowledge to settlement - and then showing the two goods pull against each other.

rows.reward: Randomisation is a property of the assigning procedure, not of the groups it produces - which is why a baseline imbalance is not a fault, why adjusting after seeing the data destroys the guarantee, and why concealment matters more than the randomness of the list.
rows.memorable: The randomness belongs to the list. The guarantee belongs to how the list was used.
rows.note: Corrects what the textbooks say in their first chapter and derives four consequences from the correction, ending with the small trial / large trial distinction that is routinely got wrong.

rows.reward: Language change enters at transmission, not use: a learner reconstructs a grammar from sentences that underdetermine it and may settle at the edges on a slightly different rule, a divergence visible only in sentences nobody said.
rows.memorable: Change enters a language at the one point where nobody is looking, and the resistance that works so well is stationed, necessarily, where everybody is.
rows.note: Sets up a genuine puzzle - nobody wants change, everybody resists it, the rate is the same - and answers it with a mechanism that explains the puzzle's shape rather than just the phenomenon. Ends without contempt for either side of the quarrel.

rows.reward: Genius stopped naming a spirit a man had and began naming a kind of man exactly when a market in originality and a form of biography needed the category - and the manufacture did real work anyway, by turning a patron's instruction into interference.
rows.memorable: Independence and unfalsifiability were purchased in one transaction, and they have not been separated since.
rows.note: Refuses both the discovery story and the debunking, which is the harder position to hold. 333 words, three questions - under-exploited.

rows.t: The Gap That Closes on the Answer
rows.reward: Curiosity is a response to a visible gap rather than an appetite: it rises as knowledge rises, collapses on any answer whatever, and can be installed from outside - which is why it carries a class to the edge of a subject and no further.
rows.memorable: Nobody can be made hungry by being informed that food exists.
rows.note: Three observations that no appetite could satisfy, then a criticism of the standard classroom advice for succeeding rather than failing. Directly relevant to this product's own design.

rows.reward: Cost explains how big lectures are, not why they are still held; the pedagogical defence is true of a minority of lectures and is offered on behalf of the rule.
rows.memorable: The form is kept for the first reason and praised for the second.
rows.note: Clean and correct, and slighter than its neighbours - the adjudication is the corpus's standard move executed without a surprise in it. 347 words, three questions.

rows.t: The Year I Made It Harder
rows.reward: Difficulty is the symptom of a transferred decision, not the ingredient: a difficulty pays only where it makes the learner perform the judgement the subject consists of, so neither the effort spent nor the volume of complaint measures anything.
rows.memorable: The change I would keep was the most resented of them all, and the change that worked best was never noticed.
rows.note: The only passage that argues from the author's own failure, and the catalogue of failed obstacles - photocopies of photocopies, seating changed weekly - is funny without ever reaching for a joke. Directly relevant to this product.

rows.reward: The liking gap is an inequality of evidence, not modesty: each party compares a private ledger of errors against a public display of warmth, which is why reassurance cannot close it and only a legible reaction can.
rows.memorable: We are reading two different documents, and only one of them records the mistakes.
rows.note: Kills the modesty explanation by listing what it would predict and showing none of it happens - a model of how to eliminate a rival account.

rows.reward: Appeals to the natural survive refutation because the word can only be used after somebody has selected which facts count - so it carries a verdict disguised as a description, and the reply that works is a question about the selection.
rows.memorable: A verdict invites an argument; a description has to be disproved.
rows.note: Explains why two centuries of refutation have landed harmlessly, which is a better question than whether the inference is valid. 348 words, three questions - under-exploited.

rows.reward: An early state survey map records an administrative requirement, not a frontier: an office could act only on a boundary that answered yes or no about a village, and the line was then made true by patrols and customs posts.
rows.memorable: The map was an instrument, and the territory grew to fit it.
rows.note: Real historical texture - graded allegiance, a monastery answering to a bishop two hundred miles away - and it ends with a usable method: set the map beside the papers produced when somebody disputed it.

rows.t: The Toll Gate and the Road
rows.reward: The social explanation of respect for difficult art cannot say why only some difficulties are honoured; the ones that are are those whose removal would remove what the work had to say.
rows.memorable: Print a novel in a type too small to read in comfort and nobody will boast of having finished it.
rows.note: Starts with the worst case at full strength, then defeats it with two counter-examples that could not be answered, and ends by refusing to prefer hard works to easy ones. rc-0029 attempts this subject and should be measured against it.

rows.t: The Leases on the Gulf Coast
rows.reward: The winner's curse needs a value common to all bidders, errors running both ways, and an award to the highest number; the travelled version keeps only the warning and becomes a claim no outcome can contradict.
rows.memorable: The part of the idea that travelled was never of any use, and the part left behind is the whole of what was found out.
rows.note: Follows an idea from the engineers who found it to the maxim it became, and shows the maxim is unfalsifiable by running three outcomes past it. Pairs with rc-0070 on the same structure - keep both, they are the two best examples of it.

rows.reward: Biology settled the magnitudes of the century after 1492 and settled nothing about the distribution, which was decided by tenure and by law - so the two questions take different evidence and neither stands in for the other.
rows.memorable: Ecology wrote the menu. Somebody else decided who ate.
rows.note: States the ecological account at its strongest before bounding it, and the paired upland societies are a real argument rather than an illustration. Answers the moral objection - that it reads as an excuse - instead of shrugging at it.

rows.t: The Officer Who Cannot Help You
rows.reward: Written procedure is slower and dearer than what it replaced and was demanded from below, because a file makes what you receive independent of whether an official likes you - which turns a favour into an entitlement.
rows.memorable: The grievance of the person refused is real, and so is the interest, which nobody ever sees, of the person who was never obliged to plead.
rows.note: The best passage in the corpus. Refutes the standard defence on historical grounds, supplies a better one, converts every familiar complaint into the same property seen from the other side, and then limits itself twice - equality of treatment and nothing more, and a fragility. Nothing in it is decorative.

rows.t: Six Miles and a Few Pence
rows.reward: The suburb was a picture for a century before cheap distance let anybody build it, so builders put up scenery a script already called for - and the script has been withdrawn while the scenery cannot be struck.
rows.memorable: We have inherited the set of a production nobody is staging, and we go on using the doors where the carpenters happened to put them.
rows.note: The stage-set analogy explains the composed front and the unplanned ground between houses, and then breaks at exactly the right joint. MISCALIBRATED: tagged difficulty 3 / easy.

tier_rule.note: Tier is derived by tools/rc-quality-report.mjs from the ten scores plus tex, so it cannot drift from the scores. tex is the one extra hand judgement: the passage carries a scene, an image doing argumentative work, or a line that lands. An argument can be first-rate and score 9.3 without it - see rc-0081, rc-0102 - and those sit in A, not S.

structural_finding: Of 115 passages, 109 begin from an account somebody else holds in order to correct it. The six that do not are the rows with corrects=0. The fam field describes how the correction is staged, not whether one happens.
